text:
tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Moves between living, bedroom, and kitchen. Do not rely on time-of-day; check the most recent known location. Prioritize coffee_table_l1 for morning/afternoon and bed_b1 for late night.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between living and kitchen table. Check coffee_table_l1 for early morning and kitchen_table_k1 for late evening.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Stays in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

mug_felix: Moves between living and kitchen. Day 21 08:17 feedback showed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. It seems to prefer the living room in the morning. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning and other times; kitchen_table_k1 only if recently moved.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 21 22:38 feedback showed bed_b1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It moves to the bedroom at night. Check bed_b1 for late-night locations; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.

glass_felix: Inconsistent. Day 21 22:59 feedback showed cupboard_k1, contradicting my guess of nightstand_b1. It does not always go to the bedroom at night; it can be stored in the kitchen. Check cupboard_k1 for late-night locations if not in the bedroom; nightstand_b1 is less reliable.
